Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retire as a stale API-cleanup proposal for an unadopted source surface, not an implemented facade. The proposed observation/relational/predictive identified-evidence ontology is absent from current modules; current MVPA exposes MvpaEngine/RoiAnalysis, response/sample/fold and feature-set contracts. This issue has no dependencies or dependents and does not identify a current public example, call sequence or consumer requiring shortening. Implementing its exact proposal now would entail first introducing a different core ontology, which is much larger than ergonomic cleanup and outside the current correctness/performance focus.

Preserve the useful design constraint (no duplicate plan/result hierarchy, hidden defaults or weakened scientific identity) as historical guidance. A future adopted API with concrete before/after examples can justify a new bounded usability task or reopening this one. The current run-axis correctness, MVPA allocation and searchlight qualification issues remain independently open; this retirement neither approves a replacement architecture nor claims conformance scenarios have been shortened. No code or tests changed.
